description: Wire the generalized primitives into every write path (onboarding submit/draft, Excel import, grid DL edit) and every display path (employee detail Details rows, grid DL cell, grid search, invoices CSV export), add the idempotent data-migration script, and apply the deliberate per-field view-guard tightening. Depends on FEAT-001 (encField, revealField, setEmployeeDriversLicense, SecretField, SecretEditCell must already exist).
steps: WRITE — onboarding: src/app/onboard/[token]/actions.ts: in BOTH submitOnboarding and saveOnboardingDraft, wrap the driversLicenseNumber, safetyCouncilId, twicNumber writes with encField(...) (import encField from @/lib/crypto). Keep ssn: encSsn(...) unchanged. Leave the expiry DATE fields plaintext.

WRITE — prefill read: src/app/onboard/[token]/page.tsx: before prefilling the OnboardingForm, safeDecrypt the three IDs (driversLicenseNumber, safetyCouncilId, twicNumber) so a resubmit does not double-encrypt. (encField idempotency from FIX5 is the backstop.) Keep SSN prefill behavior consistent with how it is handled today.

WRITE — Excel import: src/lib/employeeImport.ts: encrypt the three IDs with encField at WRITE time in the record build consumed by importRows (the createMany path). This worktree has ONLY the createMany path — add a short comment noting that; if an update branch is ever added it must encrypt too. Keep ssn: encSsn(...) as-is.

DISPLAY — employee detail: src/app/admin/employee/[id]/page.tsx: inside the {canFullView && (...)} Details <dl>, replace the plain <Detail label="Driver's license"/>, <Detail label="Safety Council ID"/>, <Detail label="TWIC #"/> rows with the SSN dt/dd shape rendering SecretField with maskedValue={maskLast4(safeDecrypt(e.<col>))}, the matching field, label, and canReveal set to the per-field canView guard: driver's license -> canView(access,'driverLicense'), safety -> canView(access,'safetyExpiry'), twic -> canView(access,'twicExpiry'). Wrap each row in that same canView guard (deliberate documented tightening — must NOT expose any field to a role that cannot already see it; per FIX1, SAFETY never reaches this section at all). Align the existing SSN row to SecretField with field='ssn', label='SSN', canReveal={canView(access,'ssn')}. Import maskLast4 from @/lib/crypto.

DISPLAY — grid DL cell + search: src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx: in the driverLicense cell, when editable('driverLicense') render SecretEditCell with field='driversLicense', label="Driver's license", maskedValue={maskLast4(safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber))}, canReveal={show('driverLicense')}; else render SecretField with the same masked value + canReveal. Keep DocLinks/UploadCell as-is. In the search haystack (~line 156) replace the raw e.driversLicenseNumber term with safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber) so search matches plaintext (mirrors the existing SSN decrypt-then-match). Also update the SSN cell to SecretField/SecretEditCell with field='ssn', canReveal={show('ssn')} if FEAT-001 left shims. Import maskLast4 (keep maskSsn/safeDecrypt imports).

DISPLAY — invoices CSV: src/app/admin/invoices/actions.ts: change the 'driverLicense' case in employeeFieldValue from `e.driversLicenseNumber ?? ''` to `maskLast4(safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber))`. FIX2: either import maskLast4 or reuse the already-imported maskSsn (it delegates to maskLast4) — pick one and make it compile. Never emit DL ciphertext to the CSV. Leave the ssn case (already masks).

MIGRATION: create scripts/encrypt-id-fields.cjs mirroring scripts/encrypt-ssns.cjs (CommonJS). Query employees where any of driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber is non-null; for each field, skip if empty or already enc:v1:, else encrypt with the same enc:v1: scheme and update that column. Idempotent (second run encrypts 0). Load DATABASE_URL + SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY from the process env with the same .env fallback as encrypt-ssns.cjs; reuse the SAME SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (never generate a new one). Log COUNTS only (and row id on per-row failure); never log a field value or ciphertext. Put the documented PowerShell run command in a header comment: $env:SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY = (Get-Content .env | Select-String '^SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY=').ToString().Split('=',2)[1].Trim('"'); node scripts/encrypt-id-fields.cjs
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding submit + draft and the Excel import write encrypted (enc:v1:) values for driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber; a resubmit after prefill does not double-encrypt.

The employee detail Details rows for the three IDs render masked last-4 via SecretField, each gated by its canView guard, with the eye only when canReveal is true; a role lacking the guard sees '—' and no eye.
The grid DL cell renders masked SecretField/SecretEditCell (never ciphertext); grid search matches on decrypted DL plaintext.
The invoices CSV driverLicense column emits masked last-4, never ciphertext.
scripts/encrypt-id-fields.cjs exists, encrypts non-null un-encrypted IDs, and encrypts 0 on a second run (idempotent); it reuses SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY and logs only counts.
No new Prisma migration was added (none is needed).
verification: From c:\Sir project\ontask\.worktrees\security-pin run: npx tsc --noEmit  (zero errors)
From the same dir run: npm run build  (exit 0)
Run the migration script twice from the worktree root (set SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY first as documented in the script header). First run prints 'Encrypted N, skipped M'; second run prints Encrypted 0.
findings:
DONE. Verification green: `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm run build` exit 0; migration run twice -> first run 'Encrypted 3, skipped 0', second run 'Encrypted 0, skipped 3' (idempotent). No Prisma migration added (fields already String?).

WRITE paths now encrypt the three IDs:
- src/app/onboard/[token]/actions.ts: imported encField; in BOTH submitOnboarding and saveOnboardingDraft the driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber writes are wrapped in encField(str(form,...)). ssn stays encSsn(...); expiry DATE fields stay plaintext.
- src/lib/employeeImport.ts: imported encField; the single createMany record build in parseImportFile now writes driversLicenseNumber: encField(str(...)) (ssn stays encSsn). safetyCouncilId/twicNumber are NOT import columns (only their expiry dates are), so only DL applies. Comment notes the worktree has only the createMany path and that a future update branch must encrypt too.

PREFILL read: src/app/onboard/[token]/page.tsx now safeDecrypts driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber before prefilling OnboardingForm (so a resubmit does not double-encrypt; encField FIX5 idempotency is the backstop). Matches the existing SSN safeDecrypt pattern.

DISPLAY — employee detail (src/app/admin/employee/[id]/page.tsx): imported SecretField (replacing SsnField) and maskLast4. Inside the {canFullView} Details <dl>, the three plain <Detail> rows for Driver's license / Safety Council ID / TWIC # are replaced with the SSN dt/dd shape rendering SecretField maskedValue={maskLast4(safeDecrypt(e.<col>))}, each WRAPPED in its own per-field canView guard: driverLicense -> canView(access,'driverLicense'), safety -> canView(access,'safetyExpiry'), twic -> canView(access,'twicExpiry'); canReveal set to the same guard. field props are 'driversLicense'/'safetyCouncil'/'twic'. The SSN row is now SecretField field='ssn' label='SSN' canReveal={canView(access,'ssn')}. Per FIX1 the whole section is already behind {canFullView}, so SAFETY never reaches it; the tightening exposes no field to a role that could not already see it.

DISPLAY — grid DL cell + search (src/app/admin/grid/page.tsx): imported SecretField/SecretEditCell (replacing the SsnField/SsnEditCell shims) and maskLast4. SSN cell -> SecretEditCell/SecretField field='ssn' canReveal={show('ssn')}. DL cell: editable('driverLicense') -> SecretEditCell field='driversLicense' label="Driver's license" maskedValue={maskLast4(safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber))} canReveal={show('driverLicense')}; else SecretField with the same masked value + canReveal. DocLinks/UploadCell unchanged. Search haystack now uses safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber) (server-scope only, never written back onto the client row) in place of the raw column, so search matches DL plaintext (mirrors the SSN decrypt-then-match).

DISPLAY — invoices CSV (src/app/admin/invoices/actions.ts): the 'driverLicense' case in employeeFieldValue now returns maskSsn(safeDecrypt(e.driversLicenseNumber)) (reused the already-imported maskSsn, which delegates to maskLast4; FIX2). Never emits DL plaintext or ciphertext. ssn case unchanged.

MIGRATION: scripts/encrypt-id-fields.cjs created, mirroring scripts/encrypt-ssns.cjs (CommonJS). Queries employees where any of driversLicenseNumber/safetyCouncilId/twicNumber is non-null; per field skips empty/already-enc:v1:, else encrypts with the same enc:v1: AES-256-GCM scheme and updates only the changed columns in one update per row. Reuses SSN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (same .env fallback + getKey as encrypt-ssns.cjs; never generates a key). Logs COUNTS only (per-field encrypted/skipped, per-row id on failure); never logs a value or ciphertext. Documented PowerShell run command in the header.

CLEANUP: the now-unused FEAT-001 shims src/app/admin/SsnField.tsx and src/app/admin/grid/SsnEditCell.tsx were deleted (no remaining importers; all call sites migrated to SecretField/SecretEditCell directly).
